description:
The American Consulate General Jeddah, Saudi Arabia has completed its analysis of the proposals submitted in response to the subject solicitation. 

  1. The sam.gov was used to invite firms to participate in the solicitation.
  2. The Government received a total of 19 proposals.
  3. The contract has been awarded to:  Arab Fist Company Ltd.
  4. The award covers Garbage Collection Services for the American Consulate General Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The total price estimate for the three years is USD78,825.60.
  5. The award was made in strict conformance with the award criteria contained in the solicitation.
